name: Jason Padgett
abstract_title: Quantum Information Holography: A Unified Gravitational-Spin Mechanism for Consciousness
abstract: We propose Quantum Information Holography (QIH), a dual-framework unifying quantum mechanics, general relativity, and microtubule-mediated consciousness. In QIH, all quantum systems are encoded as spinning quantum state vectors (QSVs) on Planck-scale qubits — a universal “light-clock” field. Gravitational objective reduction (OR) occurs when mass-separated states introduce a phase discontinuity exceeding the critical threshold ΔΘ_crit = π, equivalent to the standard collapse condition ΔE_G ≈ ħ/τ
notable: One of ~40 people worldwide with acquired savant syndrome; author of memoir; diagnosed by Dr. Darold Treffert
